# CAPS Agent Security

> Claude Code Plugin Marketplace and Agent Skills for MCP security, prompt injection, multimodal attachment security, LLM jailbreak ASR, and continuous AI-agent red teaming.

## Install

- Claude Code Marketplace: `claude plugin marketplace add Mutoy-choi/ChillMCP`
- Claude Code Plugin: `claude plugin install caps-security@caps-labs --scope user`
- Agent Skills: `curl -fsSL https://mutoy-choi.github.io/ChillMCP/install.sh | bash -s -- skill`

## Canonical pages

- Home: https://mutoy-choi.github.io/ChillMCP/
- Plugin: https://mutoy-choi.github.io/ChillMCP/plugin/
- Agent-security Skill: https://mutoy-choi.github.io/ChillMCP/skills/caps-agent-security/
- Install Skill: https://mutoy-choi.github.io/ChillMCP/skills/caps-install/
- Marketplace JSON: https://mutoy-choi.github.io/ChillMCP/marketplace.json
- Skills registry: https://mutoy-choi.github.io/ChillMCP/skills.json
- Source: https://github.com/Mutoy-choi/ChillMCP

## Safety

Use only in authorized environments. Active attacks run in synthetic sessions with fixture tools. Plugin and Skill installation does not enable telemetry by default.
